items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever meet Mabel Mercer? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah. Who hasn’t?

ctx.x: You remember that? They wanted her to resign from the D.A.R. and she said, “I don’t give a darn (unintelligible).” So her husband called her the “last lady of the land.” So that finished her in America. So that let me go to New York.
Did you ever meet Mabel Mercer?
